info.name: Muhrak API
info.description: All Muhrak API endpoints (16 Nov 2026). Use with the 'Muhrak local' environment. Log in first: each login saves its side's token. Buyer, seller and admin tokens are separate (a buyer token gets 403 on seller routes, by design).

request.description: Answers 202 for new and existing emails alike. A 6-digit code is emailed (printed in the API terminal when RESEND_API_KEY is empty).
A right code signs in. Saves the token as buyerToken (change it for a seller).

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.accessToken) pm.environment.set("buyerToken", j.accessToken);

request.description: Saves the access token in {{buyerToken}}. It lasts 15 minutes: log in again after that.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.accessToken) pm.environment.set("buyerToken", j.accessToken);

request.description: Saves the access token in {{sellerToken}}. It lasts 15 minutes: log in again after that.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.accessToken) pm.environment.set("sellerToken", j.accessToken);

request.description: Saves the access token in {{adminToken}}. It lasts 15 minutes: log in again after that.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.accessToken) pm.environment.set("adminToken", j.accessToken);

request.description: Uses the refresh cookie, whose path is /api/v1/auth (the web app's proxy). Calling the API directly, Postman does not send it: log in again instead.
Same cookie note as Refresh.
Always 202.
purpose: product_photo | seller_logo | seller_document. sizeBytes = the file's exact size in bytes (Windows: Properties > Size, not Size on disk). Saves uploadId and uploadUrl.
No auth (never send a token to storage). Headers exactly as returned by step 1 (see the Postman console). Body > binary > choose the same file. Expect 200.
The API checks the stored file. Expect status ready.
Optional q, category=<uuid>, sort name | newest.
By part number, name or machine. Optional category=<uuid>.
country: OM | AE | SA | QA | KW | BH. Optional logoUploadId (purpose seller_logo).
Type in the URL: commercial_registration | vat_certificate | owner_id | bank_proof. The upload must have purpose seller_document.
filter: all | published | draft | out_of_stock | archived. Optional q, cursor.

request.description: price: OMR text with up to 3 decimals, or null for price on request. Saves productId.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.product && j.product.id) pm.environment.set("productId", j.product && j.product.id);

request.description: version = the product's current version (a stale version gets 409).
publish | unpublish | archive | restore. Publishing needs a verified seller and a photo.
REAL Gemini call: one photo at a time. The upload must be a ready product_photo of this seller. Same uploadId again = same result, no new call. Saves identificationId.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.identification && j.identification.id) pm.environment.set("identificationId", j.identification && j.identification.id);

request.description: Send again every few seconds until status is done or failed.
filter: all | open | quoted | closed.
neededBy: asap | one_week | two_weeks | one_month | flexible. requestKey: a new uuid per request ({{$guid}}); the same key again returns the first request.

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j && j.rfq && j.rfq.id) pm.environment.set("rfqId", j.rfq && j.rfq.id);

request.description: status (optional): draft | pending | approved | rejected.
decision: approve | reject (reason required when rejecting). Each document: approved | rejected (with reason).
TAKES THE SITE DOWN. scope: whole_site | buyer | seller.
